{"local_delta": 0.03,
  "departures": [
    {"fact": "State sanctuary/shield law (Sept 2022) for transgender youth care, extending protection to families who travel into the state for that care, shielding them from child-abuse investigation or prosecution.",
     "local_evidence": "\"the first sanctuary state/province for transgender youth seeking care: young people from other state/provinces can access hormones and puberty blockers here, and the law shields families from child-abuse investigations or criminal prosecution for seeking gender-affirming care\"",
     "direction": "safer",
     "magnitude": 0.03,
     "visitor_applicability": "Directly reaches visitors only in the travelling-family/minor-care scenario (the rubric's named protective-regime category: a shield statute protecting travelling families and care access); for a lone adult trans visitor it is an operating institutional-acceptance signal rather than an everyday protection. It does not touch the inherited national border/document exposures.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false,
     "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "Corrections policy housing trans inmates by gender identity within the general population (documented to Jan 2021), with state-funded gender-affirming surgery since 2015.",
     "local_evidence": "\"coded as the single sub-unit allowing transgender inmates to be housed according to their gender identity ... first sub-unit to fund gender-affirming surgeries for transgender prison inmates\"",
     "direction": "safer",
     "magnitude": 0.02,
     "visitor_applicability": "Resident-facing custody policy; it would only reach a visitor if detained, and the record's last confirmation is January 2021 with no later instance documented. Climate signal about institutional posture, not a documented traveller protection.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false,
     "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "198 recorded anti-LGBTQ incidents in 2025 — highest raw count of any sub-unit — plus a 'dramatic increase' in hate-crime reports in the largest city.",
     "local_evidence": "\"this state/province recorded 198, the highest figure of any state/province. That ranking is by raw count only: the source supplies no population or per-capita denominator\"",
     "direction": "riskier",
     "magnitude": 0.02,
     "visitor_applicability": "The count is LGBT-wide rather than trans-specific, carries no denominator or period-normalised rate, and the sources themselves warn it does not establish higher individual risk; per the prevalence rules it is not usable as a current trans-specific exposure magnitude.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false,
     "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "July 2026 analysis placing the state in a top protective-law band (4.1) with 1.9 recorded incidents.",
     "local_evidence": "\"places this state/province in a top-tier protective-law band with a score of 4.1 and 1.9 recorded incidents ... methodology ... not stated\"",
     "direction": "safer",
     "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Uninterpretable metric (what the 1.9 counts is unstated); corroborates the statutory-protection climate signal only, not a traveller-facing protection.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false,
     "counted_in_delta": false}
  ],
  "inherited_national_exposure": [
    "Executive-order binary sex definition, removal of X markers and passport/visa marker restrictions, with reports of passports blocked or confiscated and litigation pending (national border/document regime).",
    "Entry screening: February 2025 visa flagging treating a listed gender other than assigned sex as fraud grounds for permanent ban; foreign-government travel advisories for trans travellers.",
    "Bathroom/facility bans in force in numerous states and one state-level criminal bathroom provision, with a documented arrest under such a law; the division's own facility/bathroom status is not documented either way.",
    "Prison and immigration custody harms (conversion-therapy-style corrections policies, denial of care, abuse in immigration detention) at national level.",
    "Official threat-framing: cash bounties for identifying trans activists, counterterrorism language targeting 'radically pro-transgender' ideology.",
    "National hate-crime statute covering gender identity plus partial state coverage; 2025 polling showing majority support for birth-sex markers on documents and sports restrictions.",
    "National trend of state-level anti-trans legislation and advocacy 'do not travel' designations (one further state added July 2026)."
  ],
  "uncertainty": "The division's facility/bathroom-ban status, its gender-marker and document practice for visitors, and its hate-crime statute coverage are not documented locally and cannot be assumed better than the national baseline. The 198-incident figure has no denominator and no trans-specific category, so no per-capita hostility conclusion is drawn. The identity-based prison-housing policy is last confirmed January 2021; its present force is unresolved. The 1.9/4.1 figures have no stated methodology. The positive delta rests mainly on one operating shield statute, so it is deliberately small.",
  "notes": "The division differs from the national baseline mainly through a documented, in-force care-access shield statute that explicitly covers families who travel into the state — the rubric's named protective-regime category — which supports a modest positive delta. Its identity-based prison housing and surgery funding are resident-facing custody policy (climate signal only). The raw incident count and the uninterpretable 4.1/1.9 metric do not establish per-capita or trans-specific exposure and are not counted. Net local_delta = +0.03; the inherited national border, document and facility exposures continue to govern the visitor experience."}
